0022600008.text: The Celtics, 0-1 and 12th in the East, host the 0-1 New York Knicks in the second game of Boston's season, with both teams 1 game back in their respective Atlantic Division standings. Devin Carter is out for Boston with an illness; last season he averaged 8.9 points and 18.4 minutes per game. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but in 2025-26 the Celtics lost the season series 1-3, including a 112-106 defeat in New York on April 9, 2026.
